svg.title: Window VI
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Bars and field proportions approximate; wood depth omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, blue, gray, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/window-vi/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
